title: Autostart applications on desktop environment startup
summary: Most desktop environments support XDG Autostart. You can add applications to autostart via the desktop environment's settings or by placing .desktop files in ~/.config/autostart.

steps.explain: Place a .desktop file for your application in ~/.config/autostart/. Most desktop environments also have a GUI setting to manage autostart applications.
steps.gui: Look for 'Startup Applications' or 'Autostart' in your desktop environment's settings menu and add your application there.
